Team / Alicia —

I reviewed MedicSoft_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx and added line comments in the attached 'Redwood_Privacy_Counsel_Notes.pdf'. High-level positions below and suggested compromise language where relevant:

1) Cross-border transfers (page 4–5):
- Client proposes SCCs + an addendum reference. Redwood accepts SCCs but requests retaining the section that allows Contractual Transfer Mechanism via SCC + Transition Addendum language we use (see proposed text in PDF). That provides operational clarity during future regulatory changes.

2) Subprocessor notice / pre-approval:
- MedicSoft's 30-day notice is reasonable for most subprocessors. We cannot give blanket pre-approval for hosting / infra (GCP), nor for DSP/CDN partners. Proposed compromise: 30-day notice for new app-level subprocessors; 90-day advance notice for any substantive change to our hosting provider or if processing region changes.

3) Incident reporting SLA (page 9):
- Client requests 'immediate' notification language. We propose specific timing: initial notification within 24 hours of detection, and a 72-hour preliminary report with remediation plan. See suggested paragraph in PDF.

4) Audit rights and on-site audits (page 12):
- We accept SOC 2 evidence (rolling 12 months) and a reasonable remote audit protocol. We cannot accommodate unrestricted on-site audits; propose instead an agreed remote evidence pack + a single paid on-site inspection subject to NDA and notice.

5) Retention carveouts (backups/legal holds):
- We can accept a limited carveout for legal holds and backups, but require maximum retention durations and automatic deletion procedures.

Execution/e-sign:
- Either DocuSign or AdobeSign is acceptable, provided signer capacity is verified and the signing certificate is standard. If MedicSoft prefers AdobeSign, please confirm signer names and whether they will use a delegated signatory.

I'll send the annotated language and a clean tracked-change DPA for your review by 12:00 PM today.

--
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
(attachment: Redwood_Privacy_Counsel_Notes.pdf)
